oneLiner: Chef Marie runs and jumps through a side-scrolling kitchen, gathering ingredients, stomping pests, and racing to serve.

verbs.name: run
verbs.cost: momentum makes turning slow; you can only brake on the ground

verbs.name: jump
verbs.cost: commits you to a fixed arc; no steering in mid-air

verbs.name: spiceDash
verbs.cost: consumes the rare chili and only lasts 6 seconds

decisions.choice: pause to collect the first ingredient or keep sprinting
decisions.cost: stopping lets a pest close the gap

decisions.choice: stomp the rat for points or vault over it
decisions.cost: stomping scores but mistiming kills you

decisions.choice: grab the hover ingredient over the gap or skip it
decisions.cost: skip costs a star, grab risks a fall

decisions.choice: take the chili for spice rush now or save it
decisions.cost: spice is scarce; using it early wastes the safety window

decisions.choice: clear the hot-pan hazard on the left or the right edge
decisions.cost: the wrong line puts you over a pan

decisions.choice: chain airborne ingredients for combo or rush the counter
decisions.cost: combo raises score but time pressure grows

decisions.choice: go for 3 stars (all ingredients) or settle for 1
decisions.cost: full collection means re-crossing hazard zones
